html:
Discover the authentic flavors and culture of Saigon with Vietlook Travel on this iconic food tour. Explore local markets, taste signature dishes, and experience the vibrant lifestyle of Saigonese people through their cuisine and streets.

Morning / Afternoon Session

  • Cơm Tấm – Broken Rice with BBQ Pork: Start your journey with the Saigonese specialty “Cơm Tấm.” Served with barbecue pork, vegetables, pickles, and fish sauce, this dish reveals the true flavors of Southern Vietnam.

  • Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment: Visit one of the oldest apartments in Saigon (built in 1968) and immerse yourself in the local daily life and culture.

  • District 10 Flower Market: Experience the largest flower market in Saigon. Make your own lotus flower – Vietnam’s national flower – and learn about local traditions for buying and using flowers.

  • Bánh Mì – The World’s Best Sandwich: Try the famous Vietnamese baguette filled with a variety of meats, vegetables, and sauces, a true Saigon street food classic.

  • Original Local Coffee Shop: Enjoy authentic Vietnamese coffee with its unique aroma and strong flavor.

  • Chinatown (Cho Lon): Drive around Saigon’s Chinatown to explore the diversity of nations and cultures in the city.

  • Bánh Xèo – Vietnamese Rice Pancake: Visit a local restaurant and learn how this “sizzling cake” is made. Taste it the authentic way, just like the locals.

  • Local Fashion Street: Stroll or drive along Saigon’s fashion street, experiencing the city’s vibrant shopping culture.

  • Delicious Dessert: End your session with a popular local dessert before returning to your hotel.

Night Session

  • Cơm Tấm – Broken Rice with BBQ Pork: Begin your evening with the same Saigonese specialty, freshly prepared.

  • Nguyen Thien Thuat Apartment & Flower Market: Visit the old apartment and district 10 flower market to enjoy Saigon’s evening ambiance.

  • Cambodia Market Street Food: Explore this famous local food area. Try “Banh Trang Nuong” (Vietnamese Pizza) and enjoy Peach Tea, a local favorite.

  • Bánh Xèo – Vietnamese Rice Pancake: Taste the iconic crispy rice pancake prepared by local chefs.

  • Local Fashion Street & Old Mafia Area: Drive through the historic fashion street and alleys of the old mafia district, witnessing authentic local traffic and lifestyle.

  • Bánh Mì – The World’s Best Sandwich: Enjoy another version of the famous crunchy baguette stuffed with various fillings.

  • Delicious Dessert: Conclude the night with a local dessert stop before returning to your hotel.

PRICE/PERSON: 45 USD

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Experienced Vietnamese-English speaking guide

  • Local food tastings as mentioned in the itinerary

  • Transportation: walking, local vehicle where needed

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Personal expenses outside the program

  • Alcoholic beverages

  • Tips

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children under 5: free, accompanied by parents

  • Children 5–9: 75% of tour price

  • Children 10 and above: adult price
